zh:
新南威尔士大学（The University of New South Wales，简称UNSW）成立于1949年，位于澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼市，是澳大利亚八校联盟成员，也是澳大利亚顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校下设8个学院，覆盖工程、商学、法律、医学、艺术等领域，在校生超58000人。
新南威尔士大学以工程学科闻名全球，被誉为澳大利亚的“工科之王”，在工程、计算机科学、商学等领域稳居澳大利亚领先地位，其商学院是澳大利亚最顶尖的商学院之一。学校注重产学研结合，与全球工业界深度合作，毕业生就业率与薪资水平长期位居澳大利亚前列。2026QS世界大学排名中，新南威尔士大学位列世界第20位。
en: The University of New South Wales (UNSW) is a public research university in Australia. Founded in 1949, it is a member of the Group of Eight and Australia's top engineering-focused university. The University comprises 8 faculties, covering engineering, business, law, medicine, and arts, with over 58,000 enrolled students. UNSW leads Australia in engineering, computer science, and business, with its business school among the most prestigious in Australia. It is known as Australia's 'King of Engineering' for its world-leading engineering discipline. Ranked No.20 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
